prompt:
Edit the attached AgentHarbor desktop application mockup. The user insists on a TRUE PURE BLACK BACKGROUND. Make this exact correction while preserving the existing three-column layout, every Chinese label, all messages, controls, task state and Windows title bar.

Set ALL large background surfaces — center chat, left sidebar, right task inspector and title bar — to perfectly FLAT SOLID PURE BLACK, RGB(0,0,0), hex #000000. The large empty areas MUST be visibly absolute black, not charcoal, graphite, dark gray, navy, blue-black or a photographed black material. NO gradient, texture, grain, vignette, lighting, shadows, glow, glass or surface sheen. This is a crisp digital UI, not a photo of a screen.

Use thin #242424 dividers for the three panes. Message bubbles and composer may be almost-black #0A0A0A with a subtle #282828 outline; they must occupy only the small existing control/message regions, not tint the large empty backgrounds. Off-white #F2F2F2 primary text and readable #B5B5B5 secondary text. Preserve restrained blue interactive accents and the existing small amber unfinished-task indicator. Flatten the bright avatars to quiet dark circles with pale initials. Keep the selected meeting only slightly raised above black. No new elements or extra interface density.

Preserve exact existing full-window framing and 1536x1024 dimensions. Keep visible “设计预览 · 示例数据”. Do not alter task completion status or invent real results. The dominant empty pixel regions across the entire interface must be exactly solid #000000.
userFeedback: 要黑底呢 — use true flat black across the desktop, not charcoal.
approval: User: 好的 先按照这个设计一版本吧
